plugin.name: PcpEqualiser
plugin.title: Player Equaliser
plugin.desc: Live 10-band equaliser for piCorePlayer players: changes play while you drag the sliders.
plugin.changes: Changes are no longer saved automatically: Save keeps them over a restart, Reset goes back to the last saved settings. The page shows unsaved changes and asks before you switch player or leave.
